Departures.title: Departures
Departures.description: Departure dates, capacity and status of group tours. Reserved seats change only through bookings; only admins edit prices.
Departures.upcomingHint: Showing departures from today onwards. Choose a month to see past departures too.
Departures.monthTotal: {count, plural, =0 {No departures} one {# departure} other {# departures}} this month.
Departures.truncated: This month has {count} departures but the calendar shows only the first {limit}. Filter by tour or status.
Departures.newDescription: Create one or many departures for a group tour: repeat on weekdays or paste a list of dates. Preview before saving; dates that already exist are skipped.
Departures.durationHint: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} tour: the return date follows the tour's duration.
Departures.datesHint: One date per line, as 24/12/2026 or 2026-12-24. Up to 120 dates.
Departures.capacityHint: Seats for adults and children; infants do not take a seat.
Departures.pricesPrefilled: Prefilled with the latest departure's prices; you can change them.
Departures.pricesFirst: This tour has no departures yet: enter the prices of the first one.
Departures.pricesCopied: Prices are copied from the tour's latest departure. Only an MFA-verified admin edits prices.
Departures.pricesChooseTour: Choose a tour to see the prices that will apply.
Departures.previewStale: The details changed after the preview. Select “Preview” again.
Departures.previewSummary: {created, plural, =0 {No departures} one {# departure} other {# departures}} will be created; {skipped, plural, =0 {no dates} one {# existing date} other {# existing dates}} skipped.
Departures.createCount: {count, plural, =0 {No new departures} one {Create # departure} other {Create # departures}}
Departures.created: Created {created, plural, =0 {no departures} one {# departure} other {# departures}}; skipped {skipped, plural, =0 {no dates} one {# existing date} other {# existing dates}}.
Departures.editDescription: Status, capacity and note. Reserved seats change only through bookings.
Departures.minPaxHint: Set on the tour; applies to every departure.
Departures.seatsReadOnly: Reserved seats change through bookings and are not edited here.
Departures.capacityMin: At least the {reserved, plural, one {# reserved seat} other {# reserved seats}}.
Departures.cancelHint: Only an MFA-verified admin cancels or reopens a departure.
Departures.cancelLocked: This departure has bookings awaiting payment or confirmed, so it cannot be cancelled yet; cancelling with refunds and customer emails arrives in Phase 4.
Departures.pricesReadOnly: Only an MFA-verified admin edits prices.
Departures.deleteBody: Only a departure without bookings can be deleted. The change is recorded in the audit log.

errors.toBeforeFrom: The end date must come after the start date.
errors.rangeTooLong: The range can be at most two years.
errors.datesInvalid: Some dates could not be read. Use 24/12/2026 or 2026-12-24.
errors.tooManyDates: At most 120 departures at a time.
errors.pastDate: Departures cannot start in the past.
errors.tourNotGroup: Only group tours have departures; private tours are sold through quotes.
errors.tourArchived: An archived tour takes no new departures.
errors.firstNeedsAdmin: This tour has no departures yet: an admin creates the first one (and its prices).
errors.adminOnly: Only an MFA-verified admin edits prices.
errors.pricesRequired: Enter the adult price for the first departure.
errors.belowReserved: Capacity cannot be below the reserved seats.
errors.cancelAdminOnly: Only an MFA-verified admin cancels or reopens a departure.
errors.hasOpenBookings: This departure has bookings awaiting payment or confirmed, so it cannot be cancelled yet.
errors.lastDeparture: This is the last departure that is not cancelled of a published tour. Add another departure or unpublish the tour first.
errors.hasBookings: This departure has bookings and cannot be deleted; change its status instead.
errors.duplicate: The tour already has a departure on this date.
errors.failed: Could not save. Please try again.

Departures.noteHint: Customers see this note on the tour page, for example “Early start at 6:00”. Do not put internal remarks here.
